title: Genotyping SNPs
author: Yoko Kubo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jmick4e
materials: The DNA was anonymously extracted from the blood samples (0.2 mL each) at DNA Chip Research Inc. (QIAamp® series; QIAGEN K.K., Tokyo, Japan).

steps.title: Amplify target fragments by multiplex PCR
steps.instruction: Perform multiplex PCR on genomic DNA to generate target fragments that include the SNP sites, using the DigiTag2 assay.

steps.title: Conduct multiplexed ligation and labeling
steps.instruction: Carry out a multiplexed oligonucleotide ligation assay, then execute a labeling reaction using two 5' query probes and one common probe prepared for each SNP site.

substeps.instruction: Perform the multiplexed oligonucleotide ligation assay.
Label the ligated products with two 5' query probes and one common probe for each SNP.

steps.title: Prepare 5' query probes
steps.instruction: Synthesize 5' query probes complementary to the 5' flanking region of each target SNP, incorporating allele‑specific sequences; attach one of the two end‑digit sequences CCGTGTCCACTCTAGAAAAACCT or ACCACCGCTTGAATACAAAACAT to each probe.

steps.title: Prepare 3' query probes
steps.instruction: Synthesize 3' query probes complementary to the 3' flanking region of each target SNP, adding a first digit (D1) to the 3' end of each probe.

steps.title: Hybridize probes on DNA microarray
steps.instruction: Hybridize the D1‑labeled probes to a DNA microarray (NGK Insulators, Ltd., Nagoya, Japan) using separated areas as specified.
